semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides high-precision ultrasonic liquid flow meters essential for semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: Suzhou Tsingkejiahe Technology Development Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures high-precision ultrasonic liquid flow meters used in semiconductor fabrication equipment such as CMP machines and cleaning machines. Their products support high-performance closed-loop flow control of ultrapure chemicals, crucial for maintaining process integrity in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: PFA material construction for flow meters

regional_presence.China: The company is notable for being the only one in China to have passed preliminary technical verification for high-precision ultrasonic flow meters.
